description:
Your Jurism library contains several landmark US Supreme Court cases. Using the 'Related' tab in the right-side item detail pane, create bidirectional 'Related' links between the following three pairs of cases:

1. 'Brown v. Board of Education' AND 'Tinker v. Des Moines Independent Community School District'
2. 'Gideon v. Wainwright' AND 'Miranda v. Arizona'
3. 'New York Times Co. v. Sullivan' AND 'Tinker v. Des Moines Independent Community School District'

To create a relation: Select a case in the center pane, click the 'Related' tab in the right-side detail pane, click 'Add', select the target case from the dialog, and confirm. Repeat for all required pairs.

pairs: New York Times Co. v. Sullivan
